description: Traffic lights — locations all intersections is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. This file contains the location of all traffic lights managed by the City of Montreal. The file contains the reference number of the intersection where the light is located, the names of the two streets that form the intersection, and the geographic coordinates of the center point of the intersection.This third party metadata element was ... It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
